results.bound: \tilde{\mathcal{O}}(n^2) randomized time with high probability; 2-approximation for all pairs at distance at least a constant c (c = 906)
results.previous_best: \tilde{\mathcal{O}}(n^2) time for pairs at distance at least O(log log n) (Gupta, FOCS 2025); \tilde{\mathcal{O}}(n^2) for distance at least O(log n) (Dor, Halperin, Zwick)
results.quote: Theorem 1.2. There exists a randomized algorithm that, with high probability, runs in $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(n^2)$ time and computes 2-APSP for all pairs of vertices at distance at least c, where $c \ge 0$ is a constant.
